description: Complete authentication flow (AUTH-01 through AUTH-07): Replace AuthPages.tsx stubs with pixel-perfect screens including sign-in hub with social buttons, register form, login form, OTP verification (6-digit code with resend and countdown timer), password reset request/reset screens, and email verification for social users. All screens must support AR/EN, have proper error/validation states, keyboard navigation, and form persistence.
steps: 1. Enhance AuthPages.tsx with complete AUTH-01 (Sign-in hub with Google/Facebook/Apple buttons, email option, terms link) - add SocialSignIn component inline with brand logo and hero messaging.

2. Complete AUTH-02 (Register form) - name, email, phone (+249), password confirm, terms checkbox; add account type selector (buyer_seller vs business) with icon; implement business-only fields (businessName, businessCategory dropdown from categories); form validation on submit.
3. Complete AUTH-03 (Login form) - email, password, forgot password link, remember me checkbox; add show/hide password toggle; Enter key to submit.
4. Add AUTH-04 (OTP verification modal/page) - 6 input fields for digit entry (auto-focus on digit entry), resend button with 60-sec countdown timer, error message on invalid code.
5. Add AUTH-05 (Forgot password request) - email input, validation, send reset link button; success message shows email confirmation.
6. Add AUTH-06 (New password screen) - password + confirm password inputs, password strength meter (0-100%), validation rules display, reset button.
7. Add AUTH-07 (Add email for social users) - email input, verification code option, submit button; used when social auth returns no email.
8. Update AuthContext.ts to track auth step (signin / register / login / otp / forgot / reset / add-email) and data (email, code, etc.); mock API call sequence with 500ms delay.

9. Add i18n translation keys for all auth strings (if missing): signInHub, socialSignIn, createAccount, registerSubtitle, loginSubtitle, otpTitle, resendCode, resetPassword, addEmail, passwordStrength, etc.

10. Ensure all screens responsive (mobile-first), RTL-safe (flex direction, text-align, icon placement), accessible (form labels, error announcements, autofocus), and have loading states on submit buttons.
acceptance_criteria: All 7 auth screens render without errors when navigating /register, /login, or triggering state changes in AuthContext.
Form validation catches empty fields, invalid emails, password mismatch, and short passwords; displays error messages.
OTP screen shows 6 input fields, auto-advances focus between fields on digit entry, countdown timer ticks down and re-enables resend button after 60 sec.
Social buttons (Google/Facebook/Apple) show mock login toast (no real auth backend in Phase 2).
AR/EN switching preserves form state and renders RTL layout (text-align, flex direction, icon placement corrected).
localStorage does NOT persist auth forms (security), but remember-me flag in AuthContext is respected.
Password strength meter updates on input; confirmation field validates match.
All buttons/inputs have focus states; keyboard Enter submits forms.
verification: npm run typecheck — no errors in AuthPages.tsx or AuthContext.

npm run dev — dev server runs. Visit http://localhost:5173/register, fill form, click create account; confirm no unhandled errors and success toast appears. Switch to AR; check RTL layout and Arabic translation.
Visit /login, enter credentials, press Enter; confirm login succeeds and redirects to /account. Test forgot password link flow.
Test OTP entry: click resend, observe 60-sec countdown; wait countdown to 0, click resend again; confirm timer resets.
Test password reset: email → OTP → new password flow with strength meter and validation.
Test social sign-in buttons; confirm toast message and no JS errors.
